caveat: At an exact fitness optimum, first-order effects vanish and s_mut is mostly negative and quadratic in mutation size. Stored fork genomes are post-burn-in consensuses, not necessarily exact optima; their stored optima are preserved. Background mutations, linkage and population spread are ignored; mismatches with divergence are informative, not bugs.
measured_definition: x0: state divergence; M_l: map divergence; selected/neutral at t_star
